Hi! Yesterday I vibe-coded an inventory of all the talks I could find about Dataverse. There are over 500 talks and over 350 speakers! Please check out https://talks.dataverse.org

Feedback is welcome, of course! You can open an issue at https://github.com/gdcc/talks.dataverse.org or just reply here in this topic.

Thanks for all the talks! :tada:
